units.translation: The land is Cilician, and there are gatherings of Syrians.
For the young marrow ruling within the breast is equal in age, and Ares is not in his place.
a woman left alone is nothing; Ares is not present
of those departing or going out, I advance
the middle form of the future, which alone the Attics use

where Vulcan, after he has fastened the upper parts of Prometheus' body to the rock, is ordered to proceed to the lower parts, where the scholiast says: διὰ τοῦ “χωρεῖ κάτω” [by means of “go down”] he indicated the size of the bound god.
Go down, and force his legs into rings.
For already the fully armed army of the Argives is coming near.
Every man, lord of the oar, went to the ship.
Go out, I command you, from this house quickly.
Who, not fearing the din of raging equine snortings, will go out from the gates.
by means of “go down” he indicated the size of the bound god
And apart from your race, there is no one to whom I would assign a greater portion than to you.
And a chosen ten were apart from these.
Apart from the foot-scrapers and the embroidered robes, a voice cries out.
Breathing apart from the perfumed vessels for me (heaven).
The honor of the gods is separate.
Thus Sophocles fr. 219 said χωρίτην ὄφιν [a native snake].
Keep holy silence, inhabitants of the land.
A native snake, a destroyer of travelers.
The reading is uncertain. I conjectured ἀπὸ χώρων ποθ᾽ ἑῶν εἰργομένα [driven from her own places], Hermann ἀπὸ χλωρῶν πετάλων ἐγρομένα [awakened from green leaves].
Leaving the same place for me.
Of the nightingale, as if driven from places and rivers.
